title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in preventing overfitting and ensures a unique solution.

title: Why is the Solution Unique?
text: The addition of the L2 penalty term makes the optimization problem strictly convex. A strictly convex function has a unique minimum, which guarantees a unique solution for the coefficients.

title: Convexity and Uniqueness
text: What property of the L2 regularization ensures the uniqueness of the solution?

title: Role of Lambda in L2 Regularization
text: The parameter lambda (λ) controls the strength of the penalty. A positive λ ensures that the penalty term is active, contributing to the convexity of the loss function.

hintAnswer: The solution is unique due to the convexity of the loss function.
